{{Quote|Say there's a pyromaniac on the loose. A Glottalphib who ''[&hellip;]'' uses a flame-sprayer to spit fire. So this sleemo is wanted for arson by the owner of a featherbed factory on Hijo.|Arack Dostryt, the Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook|<ref name="BHC" />}}
'''Hijo''' was an astronomical object<ref name="BHC" /> located in the [[Hijoian system]], a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Hijoian Space/Legends|Hijoian Space]].<ref name="EAOC Hijoian" /> By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], it fell within the territory controlled by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGTW" />

When [[Author/Legends|composing]] a section for an edition of the [[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]] published<ref name="BHC" /> at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' includes an [[in-universe]] copy of the [[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]. The included edition of the Handbook was published at some point following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and is annotated by [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], whose [[Death/Legends|death]] is depicted in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the formation of the Empire and the events of ''A New Hope'' in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], respectively, the included edition of the Bounty Hunters' Guild Handbook must have therefore been published at some point between those two dates.</ref> [[Arack Dostryt]], the [[Director of Recruiting]] for the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], described a hypothetical example meant to illustrate the fact that [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] could collect multiple posted [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] for the same captured individual.<ref name="BHC" />

In the example story, a [[Sleeper (furniture)|featherbed]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]] was situated on Hijo. The owner of the factory had posted a bounty on a [[Unidentified Glottalphib|Glottalphib]] [[pyromania]]c, who had committed arson. The Glottalphib escaped capture on Hijo, but eventually became wanted in other locations of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="BHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hijo was introduced via map label in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square J-8.<ref name="TEA" /> In [[2013]], Hijo was established as a distinct astronomical object by the book ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', which was authored by Wallace, Fry, and [[Ryder Windham]].<ref name="BHC" />

Although that book only mentioned Hijo in a hypothetical example in an [[in-universe]] document,<ref name="BHC" /> Fry has [[:File:JasonFryAtlas.png|stated]] that the [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] listed in Appendix section of ''The Essential Atlas'' are named after the most prominent [[Planet/Legends|planets]] or celestial bodies located in those systems.<ref name="Fry">{{PlanetSystemNames}}</ref> This article therefore considers the Hijoian system to be named in accordance with the astronomical object Hijo, which is assumed to have existed in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] independently of its in-universe description in the Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook.
